color_management.input_policy: Identify each source encoding from applicable metadata; do not infer it from filenames.
color_management.output_intent: Choose an output transform after the display target and viewing conditions are declared.

items.desired_look: Create restrained warmth while preserving neutral anchors and source credibility.
items.balance_and_matching: Balance neutrals before matching faces, environment anchors, shadow density, and highlight behavior.
items.exposure_and_contrast: Retain shadow texture and shape highlight roll-off after image inspection.

palette.intent: Keep warm and cool regions distinct rather than applying a uniform wash.
protected_colors: Protect recognition-critical complexion, costume, product, or character colors.
selective_treatments: Use local shaping only after inspection establishes its need and boundaries.

items.vfx_handoff: Verify camera and VFX render encodings independently and review integration on the exact output version.
trim_assumptions: Display-specific numeric trims remain pending a declared target and review.

story_arc: Develop the palette in step with the unit's emotional progression while retaining continuity anchors.
assumptions: No media, metadata, measurement, or display specification was supplied.
uncertainties: Input encoding, measured image state, and final display intent remain unknown.
